title: Synthetic human approval and resume prototype
raw_text: Build a local runnable prototype that pauses before one synthetic state change, accepts an API response for the same invocation, and prevents duplicate application after resume or restart.
business_goal: Verify approved Human Input pause, API resume, response mapping, and idempotent synthetic change behavior.
current_process: Pause and request approve or reject
Resume the same invocation with the correlated response
Apply the synthetic change at most once when approved
Return the completed or canceled outcome
